context.body: Noah’s characterization is set inside a worldwide judgment diagnosis rather than presented in isolation.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD sees continual human evil and a corrupt earth filled with violence; Noah finds favor and is called righteous and blameless among his contemporaries.
observations.label: Noah finds favor in a violent world: action

observations.body: Noah walks with God and fathers three sons while the earth’s corruption is repeatedly named.
observations.label: Noah finds favor in a violent world: response

observations.body: found favor · righteous · blameless · walked with God · violence
observations.label: Words in Genesis 6:5–12

payload.posture: Read Genesis 6:5–12 as name and world evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Favor, righteousness, blamelessness, and walking with God are placed together without being defined as interchangeable.
payload.title: Noah finds favor in a violent world
